text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
And so, um... if it's not too much 
trouble, any time would be fine, but could 
you tell me what you thought of the 
present?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! I just picked out something a bit 
unconventional for a present.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Reaching out again later is a pain 
in the ass. Tell me now. I'll answer you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...! Understood. What I initially 
considered was an assortment of detergent 
and hand soap."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (What is this, a year-end gift basket?)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However, I judged that doing so would lack 
intrigue, so I thought it over in my own 
way and made a decision.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
An electronic device cleaning kit. Nothing 
beats one of these...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"What do you think? I was hoping this 
would be both useful and quite the 
pleasant surprise, but...?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well... can't really deny... that it 
freaked me out, huh?
